say:4:1029216002:1.text: That really is such a shame. Even more of a shame than getting trapped here.
say:4:1029216002:1.source_cn: 那还真是令人遗憾。比我竟然会被这里困住还要遗憾。
say:4:1029216002:1.male: That really is such a shame. Even more of a shame than getting trapped here.
say:4:1029216002:1.female: That really is such a shame. Even more of a shame than getting trapped here.

say:5:1029216003:1.text: Anyway, weren't you on the trail of the escaped treasure thieves? How'd you end up here?
say:5:1029216003:1.source_cn: 说起来，你不是去抓逃跑的盗宝贼了吗，怎么会出现在这种地方？

say:6:1029216004:1.text: Well, I'd been following their tracks when I found this secret passage.
say:6:1029216004:1.source_cn: 之前，我追寻着那些逃兵们残留的痕迹，找到了这一处密道。

say:7:1029216005:1.text: I could smell it... The presence of someone powerful...
say:7:1029216005:1.source_cn: 我能嗅到，这里有强者存在过的气息……

say:8:1029216006:1.text: Powerful? Surely you don't mean a golem?!
say:8:1029216006:1.source_cn: “强者”…你该不会说的是魔偶吧！

say:9:1029216007:1.text: That's right. Since <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I parted ways, I haven't had the chance to battle someone worthy.
say:9:1029216007:1.male: That's right. Since <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I parted ways, I haven't had the chance to battle someone worthy.
say:9:1029216007:1.female: That's right. Since <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I parted ways, I haven't had the chance to battle someone worthy.

say:10:1029216008:1.text: So every cell in my body immediately started shaking, crying out for battle, and screaming for strength!
say:10:1029216008:1.source_cn: 所以那一瞬间，我浑身的细胞都兴奋了起来，叫嚣着战斗，叫...

say:11:1029216009:1.text: But that meant that I temporarily forgot where I was and ended up trapped in this puny mechanism.
say:11:1029216009:1.source_cn: 但正因如此，我一时间忽略了眼前的状况，反倒被这种弱小的...

say:12:1029216010:1.text: Basically, you didn't just fail to catch the treasure thieves, but you also got yourself trapped...
say:12:1029216010:1.source_cn: 简单来说，就是你不仅没追到盗宝贼，还把自己困住了……

say:13:1029216011:1.text: That is, sadly, the case. But there will always be some bumps in the road on my journey to finding the strongest! I've long been resigned to this.
say:13:1029216011:1.source_cn: 确实如此。不过，在追求“最强”的道路上，总是会遭遇些许...

say:14:1029216012:1.text: Hmph, you've got a silver tongue! But if it wasn't for the magister finding this place, who knows how long you could have been trapped here?
say:14:1029216012:1.source_cn: 哼，说得倒是好听！要不是主人带我们找到了这里，你还不知...

say:16:1029216013:1.text: Robin? Oh, one of the puny thieves. What about him? Did he make any progress in his training?
say:16:1029216013:1.source_cn: 罗宾？嗯，弱小的盗宝贼之一。那家伙怎么了吗，在特训中取...
say:16:1029216013:1.male: Robin? Oh, one of the puny thieves. What about him? Did he make any progress in his training?
say:16:1029216013:1.female: Robin? Oh, one of the puny thieves. What about him? Did he make any progress in his training?

say:17:1029216014:1.text: He ran away today. The magister only found this secret passage by using the magic portal Robin left!
say:17:1029216014:1.source_cn: 罗宾今天逃跑了，主人就是顺着罗宾留下的魔法门找到这条密道的！
say:17:1029216014:1.male: He ran away today. The magister only found this secret passage by using the magic portal Robin left!
say:17:1029216014:1.female: He ran away today. The magister only found this secret passage by using the magic portal Robin left!

say:18:1029216015:1.text: Is it because he felt that the current training regimen wasn't enough?
say:18:1029216015:1.source_cn: 因为现在的训练量对罗宾来说还不足够，所以他才会选择离开吗？

say:19:1029216016:2.text: And so, in search of more training, Robin chose to come here, the secret passage of the golems—
say:19:1029216016:2.source_cn: 而为了获得更多的训练，罗宾选择来到魔偶存在的密道，也就...

say:20:1029216017:1.text: But even so, desertion is a shameful matter!
say:20:1029216017:1.source_cn: 但即使如此，当逃兵也是非常令人不齿的行为！我要亲手抓到他们！

say:21:1029216018:2.text: I'll catch him and give him even more strenuous training! As intense as my own!
say:21:1029216018:2.source_cn: 给他们增加训练强度！加到和我自己的特训强度一致！

choice:15:0:1.text: Moving on... Do you remember Robin?
choice:15:0:1.source_cn: 不说这些了，你记得罗宾吗？
choice:15:0:1.male: Moving on... Do you remember Robin?
choice:15:0:1.female: Moving on... Do you remember Robin?

choice:3:1:2.text: Don't think this means we'll fight.
choice:3:1:2.male: Don't think this means we'll fight.
choice:3:1:2.female: Don't think this means we'll fight.
